We need correct SMILES. Perhaps the parentheses cause issues. Need to ensure aromatic ring closure numbers correct. Original first precursor: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1

Now replace N with NS(=O)(=O)c4ccc(F)Cl. The aromatic part: c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3 . The N is attached to aromatic carbon? Actually it's an aniline: c2cc(N)cc3c2... So N is substituent on aromatic carbon. So we need to replace that N with N attached to sulfonyl. So the aromatic part becomes c2cc(NS(=O)(=O)c4ccc(F)Cl)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3 . That seems fine.

Now full SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(NS(=O)(=O)c4ccc(F)Cl)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1

Check parentheses: N1CCN( ... )CC1 . Inside parentheses: c2cc(NS(=O)(=O)c4ccc(F)Cl)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3 . That seems valid.

Let's try search again with that SMILES.
